name: station-g20-v3-fixture-planar-fork
notes: User adopted the rendered dual AR5_5_08R_W4C4A6 scene on 2026-10-21; upstream commit e6bcf44ff0203534e14500cb836f57e9f9492292.
Both arms use the R variant. Unique link and joint names; original mesh geometry and kinematics retained.
Upstream joint_1 rpy is zero; no additional station-candidate 90-degree rotation applied.
Base mounting poses, home joint angles and hand mounts inherited from v4.3, not independently verified for this model.
Static loading and three-view rendering verified. Existing 07-model home/IK/clearance certificates do not apply; dynamics and physical alignment remain unverified.
Archived camera extrinsics and retained driver intrinsics unchanged from v4.3.

v4.5 (2026-10-22): arm mounts rotated about each base z (J1) axis, left -90 deg and right +90 deg, relative to the vendor design value used through v4.4. Evidence: with the master arm hanging naturally, the station map_left/right gives slave J1 = +/-90 deg, and the station's real slave hangs in that pose, whereas the v4.4 mount hangs at J1 = 0 and folded the sim arm backward. home_q J1 shifted by +/-90 deg to keep the same physical home pose.

v4.5 right arm (2026-10-23): an extra +15 deg rotation about the right base z (J1) axis. LinkerTA adds offset_deg=-15 to right J1 (lta.yaml and main_ros2.cpp default, 2026-08-31, comment 'joint51 -15 deg'). Inferred to compensate the real right slave, so the right arm hangs vertically at slave J1 = -105 deg; before this change the sim right arm leaned back about 20 deg with the master hanging. This is an inference and has not been measured on the real slave. home_q J1 shifted by -15 deg.
camera_3 re-aimed and recalibrated on 2026-10-23 (tilted forward about 43 deg, position nearly unchanged); see references/calibration/2026-10-23-ego-upright/.

Collection placement (user decision 2026-10-23, revised): gamepad on the edge post, root [0.709415, 0.6252, 0.986859] (220 mm above the table), yaw -90 deg, tilted 39.8 deg about its left-right axis (bumper edge up) so the face normal points at camera_3 (2.7 deg residual; camera 29 mm off the table centre line). Back-shell support point 211.3 mm above the table.
2026-10-29: back to the edge-post placement. The real fixture is planned at the calibration-board position (far table edge, centre), which camera_3 sees; the elbow-90 trial placement is withdrawn.

2026-11-03 placement trial d050-h220-t+10 (task X): gamepad centre 50 mm in from the far edge, 220 mm above the table, tilt 46.67 deg; straight 30x40 mm post on a 20 mm edge base. For teleop trials only.
V3: actual CAD visual meshes plus collision-only box decomposition. Root is derived from compressed-pad assembly, not prescribed d050-h220.
V3 vertical post axis from integer base/flange/post dimensions. Camera_3 calibration unchanged. This is a trial spec only; no service/default switch.
